US House Votes to Shelve Impeachment Proceedings Against Pete Hegseth

The U.S. House of Representatives voted 211 to 204 to effectively end impeachment proceedings against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The vote was to refer eight charges to a committee. Hegseth, described as Trump-backed, called the impeachment a 'farce' and defended his foreign policy record. The outcome occurred during a period when Republicans still controlled the House, prior to the new Congress taking office in January. President Trump praised Hegseth with an 'A Plus Plus Plus grade'.
